tool_args.rationale: The bridge signature identifies the inland-hub siphon family. The open-branch observations change y strongly as s_grad changes, supporting the two-layer inhibition term; fitting both permitted branch forms numerically to all seven rows selects the branch and estimates its parameters. The additional trajectory and nuisance measurements are not needed for this mechanism.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Already acquired; its two varied-gradient rows establish the sink-gradient response and positive-branch signal.
Unnecessary for the bridge-mapped static siphon mechanism; H and state-memory fields do not vary.
The data vary u_now and s_grad at one fixed H, and the W1 bridge note specifically maps to the static two-layer siphon.
They cannot account for the substantial response to s_grad demonstrated by the probe.
